title: resetDb is not serialised: a reset that outlives its hook timeout races the next test's reset, turning one slow test into a cascade of unrelated failures
failure_scenario: A loaded CI runner or a dev box running two suites (the release gate racing a local run, which global-setup.ts was written for) slows one reset past 30 s; instead of one timeout the file reports a timeout plus N "database already exists"/unhandled-error failures in unrelated tests, and vitest flags "This might cause false positive tests". The 44-failure baseline reads like 20 broken files when none is broken, so real regressions hide in the noise and people learn to rerun until green.
